BrandHeritage.title: The Human Core of High Tech
BrandHeritage.description: BBGeorgiaTech is the dedicated technology division of Bagauri Bonds Georgia. We inherit our parent company's deeply human pillars and translate them for the digital frontier.
BrandHeritage.bondsDesc: Technology is not about code—it's about connection. Inheriting our parent company's focus on human ties, we engineer the invisible digital threads that connect businesses to their users, creating seamless interactions across the digital landscape.
BrandHeritage.bagauriDesc: Roots matter, and digital experiences have architects. Bagauri represents the heritage and foundational integrity of our parent company. In a fast-moving digital world, BBGeorgiaTech builds on this legacy of craftsmanship, inviting you to engineer the next chapter of your digital history with us.

CoreCompetencies.precisionEngineering: Precision engineering for the digital frontier.
CoreCompetencies.service1Desc: We architect complex headless ecosystems. By separating front-end performance (Next.js) from backend logic, we build secure, infinitely scalable infrastructure.
CoreCompetencies.service2Desc: We deploy on the Edge. Utilizing Vercel and Cloudflare, your digital products load instantly worldwide, completely immune to localized server failures.
CoreCompetencies.service3Desc: From serverless Postgres (Neon) to NoSQL scale (MongoDB Atlas) and dynamic asset optimization (Cloudinary), we build systems ready for enterprise data loads.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.p1: Our infrastructure utilizes standard HTTP cookies and browser LocalStorage to maintain functional state and routing preferences. A "cookie" is a small text file downloaded onto your device when you access our network, allowing us to recognize your device and store some information about your preferences or past actions.
CookiePolicy.p2: These cookies are essential for the core functionality of our digital infrastructure. You cannot opt-out of these cookies without severely degrading the performance of the application.
CookiePolicy.li1Desc: We store a localized boolean in your browser's LocalStorage (`bb_cookie_consent`) to record whether you have accepted or dismissed our cookie banner, preventing it from constantly reappearing on subsequent visits.
CookiePolicy.li2Desc: `NEXT_LOCALE` is utilized to remember your preferred language rendering (e.g., English, French, Georgian).
CookiePolicy.p3: With your consent, we deploy performance monitoring and analytical cookies to measure network latency and user interaction.
CookiePolicy.li3Desc: Used strictly to measure Core Web Vitals (Largest Contentful Paint, rendering stability). No personally identifiable information (PII) is captured.
CookiePolicy.li4Desc: We utilize GA4 to aggregate data regarding traffic volumes and geographic routing. Google may set its own cookies (`_ga`, `_ga_*`) to distinguish unique users across sessions.
CookiePolicy.p4: You have full control over the telemetry data you provide to our network. To manage your cookie preferences:
CookiePolicy.li5Desc: You can configure your browser to block or alert you about these cookies. Check the "Help" menu of your browser for instructions.
CookiePolicy.li6Desc: To prevent your data from being used by Google Analytics globally, you can install the official
CookiePolicy.li7Desc: You may clear your browser's LocalStorage and cache at any time to reset our `bb_cookie_consent` state.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.p1: BBGeorgiaTech is committed to safeguarding your privacy. We collect minimal personal data strictly necessary for providing our services. The types of data we collect include:
PrivacyPolicy.li1Desc: Name, email address, and project details voluntarily submitted via our Secure Contact Terminal.
PrivacyPolicy.li2Desc: Anonymized usage data collected via Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Vercel Analytics to monitor network performance, routing efficiency, and user interaction.
PrivacyPolicy.p2: We process your data based on legitimate business interests and explicit consent. Your contact information is used exclusively to respond to inquiries and facilitate project scoping. Telemetry data is aggregated to ensure our global edge network remains highly performant and secure. We do not sell, rent, or distribute your data to third-party data brokers.
PrivacyPolicy.p3: Contact form submissions are retained on secure mail servers only for the duration necessary to fulfill the inquiry or ongoing project requirements. Anonymized analytics data is retained in accordance with Google Analytics and Vercel data retention policies, typically rolling over after 14 months.
PrivacyPolicy.p4a: Under international data protection frameworks, you have specific rights regarding your personal information:
PrivacyPolicy.li3Desc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
PrivacyPolicy.li5Title: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten):
PrivacyPolicy.li5Desc: Request the complete deletion of your data from our systems.
PrivacyPolicy.p4b: To exercise these rights, please issue a formal request to our Data Protection Officer at the email listed in Section 06.
PrivacyPolicy.p5: Our digital infrastructure is hosted on global edge networks (Vercel). By using our services, you acknowledge that your data may be transferred, processed, and stored across international borders, outside of your resident jurisdiction, utilizing secure, encrypted pipelines.
PrivacyPolicy.p6: For any inquiries regarding data architecture, compliance, or to exercise your privacy rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at:

TechStack.title: The Engine
TechStack.desc: We operate exclusively on a modern, Headless Ecosystem. We don't build generic websites; we engineer highly distributed, decoupled applications ready for Enterprise scale.

DeployedSystems.m1: Engineered secure digital presence for high-trust premium client conversion.
DeployedSystems.m2: Implemented high-fidelity motion architecture with headless CMS content modeling.
DeployedSystems.m3: Deployed scalable global routing with NoSQL data mapping and dynamic edge assets.
DeployedSystems.m4: Architected robust backend microservices for complex NoSQL data routing.

ParadoxOfScale.title: The Paradox of Scale
ParadoxOfScale.quote: Simplicity is the key to brilliance.
ParadoxOfScale.p1: We reject brute-force volume in favor of specialized, high-fidelity execution. True digital excellence requires a surgical approach to architecture and design.
ParadoxOfScale.p2: By ruthlessly eliminating the non-essential, we ensure every interaction feels snappy, fluid, and profoundly purposeful. Minimalism isn't an aesthetic choice; it is our operational mandate.
ParadoxOfScale.author: — Bruce Lee
